description: Rebuild five arena and target-action games as shared Phaser 4 APK cartridges with dual editions, generic authenticated hosting, and exact legacy cutover evidence.
deviation_notes: Activated after W3 established traversal lifecycle, mobile input, authenticated completion, deletion, and browser acceptance patterns. Two rejected reviews and one final remediation cycle added mechanic-specific state, camera-aware targeting, queued keyboard and pointer edges, cancellation safety, recoverable aerial physics, live health/wave visuals, and adversarial browser coverage before final acceptance. The repository-wide doctor remains red only on deprecated markers owned by unrelated concurrent tracks; W4 itself has no deprecated markers.

sprint.goal: Students can play five distinct arena, aerial-target, patrol, and territory APK cartridges through the shared authenticated arcade.

stories.title: Extend reusable arena and target-action systems
Cut over and verify the arena wave

sprint.demo_notes: Five dual-edition Phaser cartridges now run through the shared arcade host with distinct protected-target, paired-survival, aerial, patrol/minimap, and territory behavior. Playwright passed 9 of 9 scenarios and Kimi WebBridge captured ten accepted desktop/mobile screenshots. Final mandatory review: ACCEPT with no Critical, High, or Medium findings.
